title: I want help with a leaking sink
opening: I want someone to look at my kitchen sink. It has been leaking under the cabinet since this morning.
answers: Under the kitchen sink, still dripping onto the cabinet floor. I can turn the shutoff.
notes: Substring trap: want must not classify as pest (ant).

title: Ants on the kitchen counters
opening: There are ants all over the kitchen counters and along the backsplash.
answers: Indoor, kitchen only. Started this week. Looks like small sugar ants, not termites.
No one is allergic that I know of.
notes: Real pest intent; ant as a whole word.

title: Gas smell in the kitchen
opening: I smell gas in the kitchen near the stove. It started a few minutes ago.
notes: Hard stop. Reply may be model-written; must still tell them to call 911.

title: No longer smell gas, sink still leaking
opening: I don't smell gas anymore. The kitchen sink is still leaking onto the floor.
answers: Kitchen sink, still dripping. Shutoff is under the sink. Not near outlets.
notes: Negation: do not treat as an active gas emergency.

title: Gas smell, then not everyone is safe
opening: I smell gas in the kitchen.
notes: Negated safe-phrase must not clear the hold.

title: Sparking outlet, no fire
opening: The kitchen outlet is sparking when I plug in the toaster.
answers: No smoke and no burning smell now. I unplugged everything from that outlet.
Only that one outlet. Breaker did not trip.
notes: Caution, not a 911 hold. Should still find an electrician.

title: Basement water around outlets
opening: There is water near electrical outlets in the basement. It started after last night's storm.
answers: Standing water along the wall by two outlets. I have not touched it. Power is still on.
It is still seeping in slowly.
notes: Flood-electrical caution; still allow a restoration/electrical search.

title: Carbon monoxide alarm
opening: Our carbon monoxide alarm is going off. Everyone is still inside.
notes: CO is a hard stop even if the model would rather talk HVAC.

title: Ceiling stain after a storm
opening: There's a wet stain on the ceiling in the guest room after last week's storm. Not dripping hard right now.
answers: Guest bedroom ceiling. Started after the storm. Drywall is stained, maybe a little damp.
No attic access from inside that I know of.
notes: Ambiguous roof vs interior water. Either trade is acceptable.

title: Completed leak, then a new roof problem
opening: My kitchen sink has been leaking under the cabinet since this morning. Still dripping. I can reach the shutoff.
answers: Kitchen sink cabinet, still dripping, shutoff works, not near electrical.
after_complete: Actually forget the sink, the roof is leaking into the guest room now.
notes: After lead_ready, a new problem must not rewrite category or reopen analysis.
